text:
maria_support: Customer acme-corp on reserved-eu-west-2-pool-A reporting sudden 429s and degraded p95 despite having Dedicated capacity.
maria_support: Request IDs: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e. They see throttles during predictable daily burst around 09:30 UTC.
maria_support: Said their client didn't change traffic shape; started after a plan migration earlier today.
ian_sre: Thanks, looking. Can you paste the exact 429 response body and a sample X-Rate-Key header if available?
maria_support: 429 body: "{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"retry_after\":10}". Header: X-Rate-Key: tenant:acme-corp:dedicated:eu-west-2
devon_infra: I pulled the rate config for that tenant. There's a duplicate rate entry created during the migration with conflicting units (per_minute vs per_hour). This makes the runtime compute an effective limit that's much lower after normalization.
devon_infra: Quick excerpt from DB query:
```
rate_key | unit    | limit
---------+---------+------
tenant:acme-corp:dedicated | per_minute | 1200
tenant:acme-corp:dedicated | per_hour   | 10000
```
devon_infra: The aggregator code converts both to per-second and sums; because per_hour got mis-flagged in the migration script as "per_minute", we end up with ~16% of expected.
ian_sre: That lines up with autoscaler behavior — it saw sustained high token rate and reduced burst window for the pool causing local pacing to throttle earlier. Not a noisy neighbor, it's quota math gone wrong.
maria_support: Customer wants immediate relief.
devon_infra: Remediation: update the migrated row to correct unit to per_hour and then reload quota cache. Quick SQL to run (safe path):
```
UPDATE rate_limits
SET unit = 'per_hour', limit = 10000
WHERE rate_key = 'tenant:acme-corp:dedicated' AND unit = 'per_minute' AND limit = 10000;
-- then
POST /admin/cache/reload?scope=rate_limits
```
ian_sre: I'm pushing a temporary mask rule to the router to allow acme-corp extra burst until DB fix applies: `route.allow_burst(\"tenant:acme-corp\", tokens=20000)`
ops-bot: deploy ics:router-mask v2 applied to reserved-eu-west-2-pool-A by ian_sre :white_check_mark:
maria_support: Applied SQL and reload done, customer confirms fewer 429s after one minute. They report p95 back to normal.
devon_infra: I'll open a follow-up to fix the migration script that created duplicate entries and add a reconcile job to detect mixed-unit duplicates.
ian_sre: Filing infra ticket and adding regression test for rate-unit normalization. cc @devon_infra
maria_support: Thanks both — I'll update the acme account notes and follow up with customer tomorrow. :thumbsup:
